title: Deadcode: Burn the System. A game in progress I made w/ Codex and Claude
author: silveredge96
selftext:
I've been working on this for a while and it’s finally in a spot where people can play it. Deadcode is an isometric action RPG: six chapters, a city to save, and a rogue sentient AI trying to overwrite the world to its liking.

• 4 heroes to start (NightFire, Lightstorm, Darius, Lyra), beat the campaign to unlock additional character Codebreaker.

• Skill trees, loot, bosses, endgame modes and Inferno New Game+

• Play on your phone in landscape, keyboard + mouse, or controller (Xbox / Backbone)

No download, just play: [https://ragephoenix-inferno-arrow.pages.dev/test/](https://ragephoenix-inferno-arrow.pages.dev/test/)



Still a test build so expect some rough edges. First load is about 400 MB so use wifi. Would love any feedback, good or bad

comments.author: rrcecil
